label: Q.7 a.1-2 unlimited-esse claim supports the sense-fixed CREATURE_1 reception premise
note: Same support and same gap as for its Creature-parametric sibling 'The esse of every CREATURE_1 is received in some principle' (relation 904404f7): the claim's interpretation records that q.7 a.2 co. denies infinity simpliciter to a subsistent created form because its esse is received and contracted to a determinate nature. That bears on the premise for subsistent created forms; that the esse of every CREATURE_1 is received in some principle is the analyst's generalization.
